system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
You no longer age in the conventional sense. The world weathers you the way it weathers a mountain — slowly, and with reverence.

You do not age. You may still choose to eat, drink, and sleep. You are a person, not a statue.

Defending Mode. At the start of any session, you may declare a single Place you are defending — a hex, building, structure, person, faction, idea, or named treaty. While you are within / near that Place (GM call), or actively traveling toward it with no detour:

  • Resistance to all damage types. All seven RFI damage types are halved (after vulnerability, before flavor-specific overrides).

  • Reroll the lowest die on every defense check (Body, Intrigue, Soul) and every attribute check made to maintain your Place.

  • Immune to charmed, compelled, and shaken. Effects that would apply these conditions to you instead apply to the source as a feedback (GM-narrated).

  • Allies within 6 squares defending the same Place may use your Violence value or Body value in place of their own for any defense check against fear effects, forced movement, banishment, or compulsion.

Defending Mode ends if you abandon the Place voluntarily, declare a different Place, or finish a Soma Break that explicitly closes the defense (GM call). You may re-declare at the next session start.

system.requirements: Path of the Mountain, Bulwark Initiation 17
